sentences.text:
In Re: Sujauddin Sk.
@ Khandekar ... on 4 October, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
04.10.2024
Court No.29
Item No. 34
 Rejected

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code
 Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik
 Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Kandi Police Station Case No. 26
 of 2024 dated 02.06.2024 corresponding to G.R Case No. 975 of 2024 under
Sections 498a/326/307 of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In Re: Sujauddin Sk. @ Khandekar Sujauddin
 Petitioner
 Md. Hafiz Ali For the Petitioner
 Mr. Pravash Bhattacharya
 Ms. Sana Naaz For the State

1.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the statement of the victim read with medical report, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
3. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected and the same is accordingly disposed of.
4. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar, J)
